reading_rules.cost: the studentized 90% interval of d (control less arm) lies wholly below zero
reading_rules.gain: the studentized 90% interval of d (control less arm) on the grid CRPS lies wholly above zero
reading_rules.label_reading: the label is read as tested and supported, tested and not supported, or tested and undecided, on the October-window targets of the years but 2019 and 2025, and on the 2026 development days; a reading on the motivating years is circular and is not one. 'supported' is a gain there on grid CRPS or on upper-tail twCRPS with no cost on the other; 'not supported' is a cost on either, or an identical score; anything else is undecided.
reading_rules.scope: development data never gives a verdict; the result goes to the validation report's known limits as tested and not adopted, or as a known limit, and changes nothing the project claims. Any adoption is her decision.
